title: The Defender Security WordPress plugin before 6.4.1 does not verify that the client IP address it derives for its…
description: The Defender Security WordPress plugin versions before 6.4.1 improperly trust user-supplied IP address values without verifying their source. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to spoof IP addresses, bypass IP-based protections such as login lockout and IP banning, impersonate allowlisted IPs, and corrupt activity logs.
